definition.title: What Is an AI UGC Video Ad Generator?
paras: An AI UGC video ad generator makes a short ad from a product photo, a prompt or a product link. You get a script, an AI actor, a voice, captions and a cut, without filming or a separate editor.

AIVideosUGC sizes each ad for the placement you pick: 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3 or 3:4. Publish to TikTok or Meta, or download a file you can use commercially, with no watermark. Plans start at $24.50 a month.

faq.q: What is an AI UGC video ads generator?
faq.a: It makes a short, creator-style video ad from a product photo, a prompt or a product link, with a script, an AI actor, a voice and captions. You do not film it.

faq.q: How do I make a video ad here?
faq.a: Start from a product page or one clear photo. The script, actor and voice are created for you. Edit what you want, then download or publish to TikTok or Meta.

faq.q: What is the best AI video generator for ads?
faq.a: Use AIVideosUGC when you have a product photo or a product link and you want several creator-style ads in 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3 or 3:4, including a batch from a catalog.

faq.q: Is an AI UGC video ad free to make?
faq.a: No. Plans start at $24.50 a month. A 6-second ad uses 24 credits, 10 seconds uses 40, 15 seconds uses 60 and 30 seconds uses 120. You see that cost before the job starts.

faq.q: Do I own the rights to the video ads I make?
faq.a: You can use finished clips commercially in paid ads and organic posts, and they carry no watermark.

faq.q: What sizes and platforms can I make ads for?
faq.a: Choose 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3 or 3:4 for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and Meta. You can publish to TikTok or Meta from the same screen.

faq.q: Can I make a video ad for every product at once?
faq.a: Yes. Paste the product links or connect the products you want, and make an ad for each one instead of starting every clip by hand.

faq.q: Which video lengths can I choose?
faq.a: Choose 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds. Pick the length that gives one action a clear beginning and end.

faq.q: How many credits does a video ad cost?
faq.a: A 6-second video uses 24 credits, 10 seconds uses 40, 15 seconds uses 60 and 30 seconds uses 120. Failed jobs return credits automatically.

faq.q: Can an AI video ad stand in for one filmed by a creator?
faq.a: It depends on the product and the audience. Use these clips to try more openings, and book a real creator when you need a filmed campaign.

faq.q: Do Meta or TikTok flag ads made with AI?
faq.a: Check the current rules on Meta and TikTok before you scale spend. Disclose AI content when a platform asks you to, especially if shoppers could take the ad for a real buyer review.

faq.q: Is the presenter a real customer?
faq.a: No. The presenter is AI-generated, not a customer endorsement. Keep the scene factual, and disclose AI content when a platform requires it.

faq.q: Can I change captions, the voice or the music?
faq.a: Yes. Captions are written with the script, and you can edit them. Swap the voice, and pick a track from the music library or add your own licensed music, before you publish.

faq.q: Can I request ads through an API?
faq.a: Yes. An API can request ads from a product catalog in your own tool. Each clip still uses credits, and you see that cost before the job starts.
